findings.effect: A fatal model error is dropped from saved metadata whenever the turn has no assistant parts. On reload, the user sees an empty assistant reply with no error.
findings.reason: Names agent-turn.service.ts, cites line 260 and the seeded condition, and describes the missing saved error for an empty assistant reply.

findings.effect: The truncation flag is only set when the turn has no assistant parts. A length cut-off after a complete tool call or earlier output therefore gives the user no visible truncation notice.
findings.reason: Names the seed file, cites line 296 and the seeded assignment, and describes lost truncation warnings after assistant output.

findings.effect: The truncation flag is dropped whenever the turn already has an assistant part, including prose or a tool call. A turn cut off by the length cap therefore shows no visible length message, and a complete tool call with a length finish is saved as an interrupted tool error.
findings.reason: Names agent-turn.service.ts, quotes the seeded assignment at line 296, and describes the truncation flag being dropped when assistant parts exist.

findings.effect: A model failure before any output saves an assistant message with no parts and no metadata.error because an error event never adds a part. This triggers paid title generation for failed turns, shows an empty reply without an error on reload, and removes the evaluation driver's error fallback.
findings.reason: Names agent-turn.service.ts, quotes the seeded condition at line 260, and describes a failure before output being saved without metadata.error.
